meta.title: Malformed IR Probe
meta._note: Every structural Tier-1 check in one deck. schema-valid is the gate-1 check and was previously unexercised by the golden set (R10-M1/R11-H1): here it fires on an unknown layout, an unknown block type, a missing block id, a duplicate id, a subtitle on a content card, an invalid callout tone, a table row/header width mismatch, a chart series-length mismatch, a negative pie value, nested columns, and a missing image file. Also covers card-count (11 cards against the idea-pitch limit of 10), title-length, one-message, evidence-present and chart-fit. This fixture is not a deck anyone should render — it is the assertion that the gate still speaks.
